purpose: Teach: 気功/狂牛病/磁場/下水道/社会保険庁/地表/脱臼/精油

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、気功と称した詐欺事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police handle cases of fraud involving qigong, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, seeking confirmation. Measured pacing. Genuine curiosity underneath the formal phrasing. Slight upward inflection at the end—not aggressive questioning, but intellectual probing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、狂牛病感染牛の不正流通も捜査します
lines.en: The police also investigate illegal distribution of beef infected with mad cow disease.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, informative tone. Steady cadence, no emotion attached. Professional briefing—the facts as they are. Slight pause between clauses for clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、磁場を悪用した盗難を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And theft cases that involve misuse of magnetic fields—those are handled by the police too?
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate than the first line. Testing the premise. Genuine wonder at how broad the scope is. Soft upward turn at the end—still questioning, still learning.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、下水道での失踪事件も担当します
lines.en: The police also handle missing-person cases that occur in sewers.
lines.style: Same steady, procedural tone as before. No judgment, no surprise. Just listing jurisdiction. Brief, clear. The specificity delivered without fanfare.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、社会保険庁関連の不正を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So fraud cases related to the Social Insurance Agency—those also fall under police jurisdiction?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity again. Trying to understand the boundaries. Slower articulation on the institutional name. Genuine—not testing the officer, but learning from him.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地表の痕跡を鑑識しますね
lines.en: The police conduct forensic examination of traces found on the ground surface.
lines.style: Level, informative delivery. The word 'forensic' gets slight weight—it's a skilled task. Professional precision. No rush. Straightforward explanation of procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の脱臼を、警察、医療連携で対応されますね
lines.en: I imagine the police coordinate with medical specialists when victims have injuries like dislocations?
lines.style: Respectful curiosity. Slower opening. Genuine wonder at how systems connect. The phrasing shows Ren thinking aloud—not interrogating, but genuinely piecing together how this works.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、精油成分鑑定を依頼される事もありますね
lines.en: Yes, we sometimes request analysis of essential oil compounds during investigations.
lines.style: Warm, slightly more open than previous responses. Still professional, but a subtle shift—Takeda acknowledging Ren's genuine interest with a more personal connection. Slightly less distance.
